newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Arlington County, Va., $34 mln.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Arlington County, Va., $34 mln.

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by Arlington County, Virginia (County''), until 11:00 a.m., local time, on

at the Office of the Department of Management and Finance, Arlington County, #1 Courthouse Plaza, Suite 501, 2100 Clarendon Boulevard, Arlington, Virginia 22201 for the purchase of $34,200,000 General Obligation Public

Improvement Bonds, Series 1997 (Bonds''). The Bonds will be general obligations of the County secured by a pledge of the County's full faith and credit and unlimited taxing power. The Bonds will be issued in fully registered form in denominations of $5,000 and multiples of $5,000. The Bonds will be dated June 1, 1997, and will mature serially on June 1 in each of the years 1998 to 2017, inclusive. The Bonds will be callable on or after June 1, 2007, as described in the detailed Official Notice of Bond Sale. The approving opinion of McGuire, Woods, Battle & Boothe, L.L.P.,
Richmond, Virginia, will be furnished to the successful bidder at the expense of the County. Additional information including the detailed Official Notice of Bond Sale, the Official Bid Form and the

Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained from the County's Department of Management and Finance, Arlington County, #1 Courthouse Plaza, Suite 501, 2100 Clarendon Boulevard, Arlington, Virginia 22201, (telephone: 703-358- 3415) or the County's Financial Advisor, Government Finance Group, Inc., 4350 N. Fairfax Drive, Suite 410, Arlington, Virginia 22203 (telephone: 703-528-5785).
